newsitem.title: UK: July UK RPI outlook -from the ONS.
newsitem.headline: July UK RPI outlook -from the ONS.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics offered the following outlook for July RPI --

Seasonal food prices tend to fall in July although poor crop conditions may have affected supply, especially for fresh vegetables. For non-seasonal food, there may be rises in prices of beef and tea in the near future, the ONS said.

There will be further increases in mortgage interest rates in July as many lenders raised rates following a quarter-point base rate rise on June 6. The rises are likely to be around 0.3 to 0.35 percentage points and will affect existing lenders from July 1.
But some mortgage lenders have not responded.
The bulk of summer sales of clothing and footwear and household services are expected to affect the RPI index in July.
From July 1, quarterly telephone line rentals will rise slightly and affect the index for three months from July.
For motoring, petrol prices are expected to rise in July as a result of duty increases announced in last week's budget.
